title: Health Economics Associate
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve. 
 
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do. Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference. Key Accountabilities: 
 Project Execution Works effectively within a team environment but may work independently delivering services within their area of competence. Works within broad project guidelines as directed by the project lead/ manager and/or Technical SMEs Takes initiative to prioritize work to achieve specified project outcomes while confirming alignment with project lead and line manager. Capitalizes on opportunities to improve one’s own performance and seeks feedback from the project lead/ manager and colleagues. Applies information provided by the project lead/manager or senior colleagues to complete assigned project activities. With guidance produces quality work that meets the expectations of project lead/ manager and the client May support the project lead with project management activities. Interpersonal and intercultural communication skills 

 Skillsets 
 Execute end-to-end Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs), including screening, data extraction, protocol design, and feasibility assessments. Develop high-quality evidence deliverables such as reports, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and presentations. Collaborate with Project Leads and SMEs to deliver client-ready outputs while ensuring quality and timelines. Support consulting, client interactions, and proposal development for HEOR projects. Demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with a keen interest in healthcare and research.

Key Skills: Data extraction,Medical writing,Writing,Healthcare,Drug safety,Extraction,Heor,Safety
